symbols.name: SoneAlertDirective
symbols.description: An attribute COMPONENT (still `[soneAlert]`, still `SoneAlertDirective`): the close button of a `dismissible` alert has to be rendered on the server too, which a directive cannot do. The children are projected unchanged.

inputs.name: dismissible
inputs.description: Adds a close button at the end; the owner removes the alert on `(dismissed)`.

inputs.name: closeLabel
inputs.description: The close button's accessible name.

inputs.name: dot
inputs.description: A leading status dot in the badge's colour (the `<span class="badge-dot">` part, drawn for you).

symbols.name: SoneBadgeRemoveDirective
symbols.description: `button[soneBadgeRemove]` — the remove button inside a removable badge (a tag chip). Put the glyph inside (`<sone-icon icon="close" />`) and name it by what it removes: `aria-label="Remove design"`. `type` defaults to `button`.

inputs.name: floating
inputs.description: An opaque, raised banner for an overlay (a fixed notice over the page): the overlay surface, a strong (or status-coloured) border and a large shadow instead of the translucent status tint, which would let the content underneath show through.

symbols.name: SoneBarChartComponent
symbols.description: `<sone-bar-chart>` — a column chart for a short series (a day per bar). Bars are HTML boxes, not a stretched SVG: crisp edges and real rounded corners at any width, and hover, focus and tooltip positioning are plain CSS. One Tab stop with a roving focus (Left/Right/Home/End); each bar is an image named by its tooltip, and a visually hidden table carries the data for screen-reader browsing.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: The bars, left to right (oldest first for a time series).

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: The plot height in CSS pixels (ticks sit below it).

inputs.name: yMax
inputs.description: The top of the value axis; defaults to `niceCeiling(values, 4)`.

inputs.name: tick
inputs.description: The axis label under a bar, or `null` for none; no function, no axis row.

inputs.name: tooltip
inputs.description: A bar's tooltip and accessible name; defaults to “label: value”.

inputs.name: zero
inputs.description: How a zero value draws: a flat stub (`baseline`) or nothing (`gap`).

inputs.name: tone
inputs.description: The bar colour.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Names the chart and captions its data table (“Meetings per day, last 30 days”).

inputs.name: valueFormat
inputs.description: Formats values in the default tooltip and the data table.

inputs.name: categoryHeader
inputs.description: The data table's category column header.

inputs.name: valueHeader
inputs.description: The data table's value column header.

symbols.name: SoneBarListComponent
symbols.description: `<sone-bar-list>` — a ranked list of labelled horizontal bars with the value written next to each (Tremor's BarList). A real `<ul>`: every row reads as “label value”, the bar itself is decoration.

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: The rows, drawn in the order given (sort them yourself for a ranking).

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: What a full bar means: the largest value (`max`) or the sum of all values (`total`).

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: A fixed full-bar value instead of the one `scale` computes (e.g. a quota).

inputs.name: valueFormat
inputs.description: Formats `value` when an item has no `valueLabel`; default: a localized number.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Names the list (“Tokens by model”).

symbols.name: SoneBarListLabelDirective
symbols.description: `<ng-template soneBarListLabel let-item>` — renders each row's label instead of its text (a badge, an avatar, a link). `soneBarListLabelOf` only TYPES `let-item` when the items carry extra fields.

symbols.name: SoneChartLegendComponent
symbols.description: `<sone-chart-legend>` — the key of a chart: a swatch, a label and an optional value per series. `toggleable` turns every item into a toggle button (`aria-pressed` = the series is shown) that updates `hidden` (two-way) and emits `toggle` with the item's key.

inputs.name: hidden
inputs.description: Keys of the series that are switched off.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Names the list (e.g. "Series"); optional.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale for numeric values; defaults to the active `$localize` locale.

outputs.name: toggle
outputs.description: The key of the item the user toggled.

symbols.name: SoneSwatchDirective
symbols.description: `span[soneSwatch]` — the colour key of a series: a dot, a square or a short line. Decorative (`aria-hidden`); the text next to it carries the meaning. `tone` is a token suffix (`chart-3`, `graph-note`, `success`), a custom property name (`--brand`) or any CSS colour; empty uses `currentColor`. Size it with `--swatch-size`.

symbols.name: SoneCommandComponent
symbols.description: `<sone-command>` — a filterable command list (shadcn/ui Command, spartan/ui brn-command): a combobox input over a listbox. The input keeps focus; the highlighted option is announced through `aria-activedescendant`. Arrow keys, Home / End and PageUp / PageDown move the highlight, Enter selects it. Filtering is built in (case- and accent-insensitive, item `value` + `keywords`); set `shouldFilter` to `false` when the list already comes filtered from a server.

inputs.name: search
inputs.description: The search text — `[(search)]`; the `soneCommandInput` writes it.

inputs.name: shouldFilter
inputs.description: Filter the items by `search`. Turn off for server-side search.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.description: A custom match function (default `soneCommandFilter`).

inputs.name: loop
inputs.description: Arrow keys wrap from the last option to the first.

inputs.name: active
inputs.description: The highlighted option's value — `[(active)]`.

symbols.name: SoneCommandDialogComponent
symbols.description: `<sone-command-dialog>` — a `sone-dialog` sized and padded for a command palette (shadcn/ui CommandDialog). Project a `<sone-command>` into it; render it with `@if` and close it on `(dismiss)`, like any dialog. Escape, the scrim and focus return come from `sone-dialog`.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Names the dialog for assistive technology.

symbols.name: SoneCommandEmptyDirective
symbols.description: `[soneCommandEmpty]` — shown only when no option matches.

symbols.name: SoneCommandGroupComponent
symbols.description: `[soneCommandGroup]` — a labelled group of options; it hides when none of them match.

symbols.name: SoneCommandInputDirective
symbols.description: `input[soneCommandInput]` — the combobox that searches the command list and keeps focus.

symbols.name: SoneCommandItemDirective
symbols.description: `[soneCommandItem]` — one option. `value` is what the search matches (default: the text content) and what `select` emits; `keywords` match too.

outputs.name: select
outputs.description: Chosen with a click or Enter; emits the item's value.

symbols.name: SoneCommandListDirective
symbols.description: `[soneCommandList]` — the listbox; it scrolls when the options overflow.

symbols.name: SoneCommandSeparatorDirective
symbols.description: `[soneCommandSeparator]` — a divider between groups; hidden while searching.

symbols.name: SoneCopyButtonComponent
symbols.description: Copies `value` to the clipboard from the click handler (nothing runs on the server), swaps to a "Copied" state for `resetAfter` ms and announces it in a polite live region.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The text that goes to the clipboard.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Default: `sm`, or `icon-sm` when `iconOnly`.

inputs.name: iconOnly
inputs.description: Only the glyph; `label` / `copiedLabel` become its accessible name.

inputs.name: resetAfter
inputs.description: How long the "Copied" state lasts, in ms.

symbols.name: SoneDurationPipe
symbols.description: `{{ meeting.durationS | duration }}` → `12m 5s`, `1h 2m`, `45s` — see `durationLabel`.

symbols.name: SoneTeleportToBodyDirective
symbols.description: Moves the host element to `document.body` so a `position: fixed` overlay always anchors to the viewport, not to an ancestor with `transform` / `filter` / `backdrop-filter` / `perspective` / `will-change` / `contain`. With `teleportAnchor` set (the element that opened it), a dialog or sheet the host was declared inside keeps treating it as its own content: its focusable elements join the dialog's Tab cycle right after the anchor (`SONE_FOCUS_SCOPE`). TEARDOWN: when the host `@if` flips false, Angular removes the view's DOM nodes via their CURRENT parent (`document.body`) before destroy hooks run — the node is already gone by the time `onDestroy` fires. Never move it back to its original slot; that would resurrect an already-removed overlay.

inputs.name: teleportAnchor
inputs.description: The element that opened this overlay; joins it to the enclosing dialog's focus scope.

symbols.name: SoneDockComponent
symbols.description: A toolbar of drawing tools docked to one edge of a canvas — `position` picks the edge (top, bottom, left, right) and with it the direction: a row on top or bottom, a column on the sides. `floating` (the default) pins it inside the nearest positioned ancestor; without it the dock sits in the flow. A WAI-ARIA toolbar: one Tab stop, arrow keys along its direction, Home / End.

inputs.name: position
inputs.description: The edge it docks to.

inputs.name: align
inputs.description: Where along that edge: centred, or at its start or end.

inputs.name: floating
inputs.description: Pin to the edge of the nearest positioned ancestor (`position: relative`).

symbols.name: SoneDockGroupDirective
symbols.description: A labelled run of related tools (`role="group"`).

symbols.name: SoneDockItemDirective
symbols.description: One tool of a dock — an icon button named by `label`, which is also its tooltip (with the `shortcut`, if any). `[active]` makes it a toggle (`aria-pressed`): the current drawing tool. Leave it unset for a plain action (zoom, undo).

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: The accessible name and the tooltip.

inputs.name: shortcut
inputs.description: A key that picks the tool (`V`, `Shift+R`) — shown in the tooltip, announced as `aria-keyshortcuts`.

inputs.name: active
inputs.description: `true` / `false`: a toggle; unset: a plain button.

symbols.name: SoneDockSeparatorDirective
symbols.description: A rule between groups of tools, across the dock's direction.

symbols.name: SoneEmptyStateComponent
symbols.description: `<sone-empty-state>` — spartan/ui Empty. Two ways to fill it, which combine: - **Slots** — project the parts (`[soneEmptyHeader]` › `[soneEmptyMedia]`, `[soneEmptyTitle]`, `[soneEmptyDescription]`, then `[soneEmptyContent]`). - **Composed** — set `icon`, `title`, `description` and `tone`, and the header is drawn for you; anything projected (actions in `[soneEmptyContent]`, a hint line) follows it. `tone`: `locked` defaults the icon to `lock`; `error` to `alert-circle` and announces with `role="alert"`; `loading` (or `busy`) swaps the media for a spinner and announces with `role="status"`. The effective tone is on the host as `data-tone`.

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: The media glyph. Defaults to `lock` for `tone="locked"`, `alert-circle` for `"error"`.

inputs.name: busy
inputs.description: Shows the loading state (spinner, `role="status"`) whatever the `tone`.

inputs.name: closeLabel
inputs.default: $localize`:Button that hides the floating recording bar:Hide`

inputs.name: closable
inputs.description: Show the trailing close button.

inputs.name: dragRegionAttr
inputs.description: An attribute that marks the bar's chrome as the window's drag handle — Tauri's `data-tauri-drag-region`. Set on the bar's own background element, so projected content needs none of its own. `null` = no attribute.

inputs.name: dragRegionValue
inputs.description: The attribute's value. `deep` (default): Tauri 2.11 drags from anywhere inside the bar except buttons, links, inputs and labels; `""`: the background only.

symbols.name: SoneFlowComponent
symbols.description: A node canvas for diagrams and workflows. Nodes sit at `x`/`y` in canvas units, edges join their ports with a bezier, step or straight path; the canvas pans (drag the background, or scroll with `panOnScroll`), zooms (Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel, a pinch, the controls) and fits its content. `nodes`, `edges`, `viewport` and the selection are two-way: dragging a node, drawing a connection or deleting writes them back. Children: `<sone-flow-controls>`, `<sone-flow-minimap>`, `[soneFlowPanel]` overlays and a `<sone-dock>` sit on top of the canvas.

inputs.name: interactive
inputs.description: `false` locks the canvas: no dragging, connecting or deleting (panning and zooming stay).

inputs.name: edgeType
inputs.description: The path of edges that set no `type`.

inputs.name: snapToGrid
inputs.description: Snap dragged nodes to the grid.

inputs.name: tool
inputs.description: Dragging the background pans in both tools; `pan` also stops nodes from moving.

inputs.name: fitView
inputs.description: Fit the nodes into view once they are first measured.

inputs.name: panOnScroll
inputs.description: A plain wheel pans the canvas (otherwise it scrolls the page; Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel always zooms).

inputs.name: autoConnect
inputs.description: Add the edge on `(connect)` (`false`: only emit it, the owner adds it).

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: The canvas's accessible name (default "Flow diagram").

outputs.name: canvasClick
outputs.description: A click on the empty canvas, at that point in canvas units.

symbols.name: SoneFlowControlsComponent
symbols.description: Zoom in, zoom out, fit view, the zoom level (a reset to 100%) and a lock toggle for the `<sone-flow>` it sits in.

inputs.name: showZoom
inputs.description: Show the zoom level as a button that resets it to 100%.

symbols.name: SoneFlowMinimapComponent
symbols.description: A small overview of the whole `<sone-flow>`: every node as a block and the visible area as a frame. Click or drag in it to move the view there. A pointer shortcut — the keyboard has the controls and Tab between nodes — so it is hidden from assistive technology.

symbols.name: SoneFlowNodeTemplateDirective
symbols.description: `<ng-template soneFlowNode let-node let-selected="selected">` draws the body of every node instead of the default icon, label and description. The canvas keeps the box, the selection, the dragging and the connection handles. Controls inside the template (buttons, inputs) work as usual and never start a drag.

symbols.name: SoneFlowPanelDirective
symbols.description: Pins projected content (a legend, a run button) to a corner or edge of the canvas.

symbols.name: SoneGraphCanvasDirective
symbols.description: The canvas part of `<sone-graph>`: binds a `GraphScene` to the framework-free `SoneGraphEngine`. The engine (and with it `getContext`, `matchMedia` and the observers) is created after the first render, so the directive is SSR-safe. Use it on its own when you build the scene yourself.

inputs.name: scene
inputs.description: The positioned nodes, edges, columns and clusters to draw.

inputs.name: tones
inputs.description: Tone name → custom property (or `"--a, --b"` fallback chain).

outputs.name: nodePick
outputs.description: The user picked a node with the pointer or keyboard; `null` clears.

outputs.name: nodeOpen
outputs.description: Double-click, or Enter on the picked node.

outputs.name: zoomChange
outputs.description: Zoom in percent of the fitted view.

outputs.name: anchor
outputs.description: Screen position of the hovered (else the picked) node, for a floating card.

symbols.name: SoneGraphCardComponent
symbols.description: The node card of a graph. Floating, it sits above (or below, near the top edge) the node at `anchor` and ignores the pointer; `pinned`, it docks to the bottom-left corner and offers the `openLabel` action. `data-node-x` / `data-node-y` expose the node's on-screen position for tests.

inputs.name: tone
inputs.description: Any CSS colour for the swatch, e.g. `var(--graph-note)`.

inputs.name: openLabel
inputs.description: The text of the open action of a pinned card; `null` hides it.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: Replaces the heading and meta lines.

symbols.name: SoneGraphCardTemplateDirective
symbols.description: `<ng-template soneGraphCard let-node let-pinned="pinned">` replaces the body of the node card (title + meta); the card's position and its Open action stay.

symbols.name: SoneGraphComponent
symbols.description: An interactive network diagram on a Canvas 2D: `force`, `clusters` (communities with hulls) or `layers` (one column per `layer`) layouts; drag to pan, wheel to zoom at the cursor, click to select and highlight the neighbourhood, double-click or Enter to open; full keyboard support with spoken selections, an optional node list, and colours read from the theme tokens.

inputs.name: tones
inputs.description: Extra or overriding tones: tone name → custom property, or a `"--a, --b"` fallback chain.

inputs.name: sizing
inputs.description: The radius range node sizes are mapped onto.

inputs.name: layerLabels
inputs.description: Column titles of the `layers` layout, by `layer`.

inputs.name: clusterLabel
inputs.description: The title of a `clusters` community; return `""` for none.

inputs.name: describe
inputs.description: The meta line of a node's card, its list entry and its announcement.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: The canvas's accessible name; defaults to the node and link counts.

inputs.name: summary
inputs.description: The counts in the controls panel; `""` hides them.

inputs.name: layoutStrategy
inputs.description: Computes the layout elsewhere (a Web Worker); `null` lays out on the main thread.

inputs.name: listToggle
inputs.description: Shows the List button in the controls.

inputs.name: selected
inputs.description: The selected node id.

inputs.name: showList
inputs.description: Renders the nodes as a list of buttons under the canvas.

outputs.name: zoomChange
outputs.description: Zoom in percent of the fitted view.

symbols.name: SoneGraphControlsComponent
symbols.description: The overlay toolbar of a graph: an info panel (legend, counts — projected) and Fit / zoom out / zoom readout / zoom in, plus an optional list toggle. One tab stop; arrow keys, Home and End move between the buttons (WAI-ARIA toolbar).

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the toolbar.

inputs.name: zoomPct
inputs.description: The zoom readout, in percent of the fitted view.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: `true` / `false` shows the list toggle pressed / not pressed; `null` hides it.

symbols.name: SoneGraphLegendDirective
symbols.description: Marks content projected into the controls' info panel (a legend, counts).

symbols.name: SoneInputNumberComponent
symbols.description: A number field with − and + buttons — a quantity in a cart, a count in a form. The field is a WAI-ARIA spinbutton: ↑ / ↓ step, Page Up / Page Down step × 10, Home / End jump to `min` / `max`; typed text is parsed and clamped on blur or Enter. A ControlValueAccessor of `number | null`, or `[(value)]`.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: The field's accessible name, when no `<label for>` names it.

inputs.name: decrementLabel
inputs.default: $localize`:Button that lowers a number field by one step:Decrease`

inputs.name: incrementLabel
inputs.default: $localize`:Button that raises a number field by one step:Increase`

symbols.name: SoneInputOtpComponent
symbols.description: shadcn's InputOTP approach: ONE real `<input autocomplete="one-time-code">` lies transparent over the slots, so paste, SMS / password-manager autofill, IME and screen readers all see a normal text field; the slots only draw it. The caret is kept at the end — a code is typed or pasted, then erased.

inputs.name: length
inputs.description: How many characters the code has.

inputs.name: pattern
inputs.description: What ONE character may be: a RegExp or its source (`SONE_OTP_DIGITS`, `SONE_OTP_ALPHANUMERIC`).

inputs.name: groups
inputs.description: Slots per group, a separator between groups — `[3, 3]`. Ignored unless it adds up to `length`.

inputs.name: ariaDescribedby
inputs.description: Extra ids for `aria-describedby` on the real input.

outputs.name: complete
outputs.description: Every slot is filled by the user (typed, pasted or autofilled).

inputs.name: role
inputs.description: `menu` by default; `listbox` (or `null`) when the panel is not a menu.

inputs.name: role
inputs.description: `menuitem` by default. Pass `option` inside a listbox, or `null` to drop it; for a check / radio item use `soneMenuCheckboxItem` / `soneMenuRadioItem`.

symbols.name: SoneMenuTriggerDirective
symbols.description: `[soneMenuTrigger]` — a menu button (spartan/ui `brnMenuTrigger`, WAI-ARIA menu button pattern): opens a `[soneMenu]` panel, moves focus over its items with Arrow keys, Home / End and typeahead, activates with Enter / Space and closes on activation, Escape, Tab or a click outside. Items leave the Tab order while open.

symbols.name: SoneOverlayTriggerBase
symbols.description: The open / close / place / dismiss logic shared by `sonePopoverTrigger` and `soneMenuTrigger` (spartan/ui's brnPopoverTrigger / brnMenuTrigger). The panel is rendered into an overlay layer appended to `<body>` (so no ancestor's `overflow`, `transform` or stacking context can clip it), placed next to the trigger with `computeFloatingPosition`, and re-placed on scroll and resize.

inputs.name: side
inputs.description: The side of the trigger the panel opens on; it flips when that side lacks room.

inputs.name: align
inputs.description: Alignment along the trigger's edge.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: Gap between the trigger and the panel, in px.

inputs.name: open
inputs.description: Shown or not — `[(open)]`.

inputs.name: keepOpenOnOutsideClick
inputs.description: Keep the panel open on a click outside it (Escape still closes it).

symbols.name: SonePopoverTriggerDirective
symbols.description: `[sonePopoverTrigger]` — opens a non-modal popover next to its host (spartan/ui `brnPopoverTrigger`). Pass an `<ng-template>` (`let-close` closes it) or a `[sonePopover]` panel by reference (`#pop="sonePopover"`). It closes on Escape and on a click outside, returning focus to the trigger; inside a `sone-dialog` the panel joins the dialog's focus trap.

symbols.name: SoneMeterComponent
symbols.description: Not `<sone-progress>`: a relative rating with no unit announces a sentence ("Accuracy: 4 of 4") instead of `aria-valuenow`, which would invite being read as a percentage.

symbols.name: SonePasswordInputComponent
symbols.description: A password field with a show / hide toggle, on the Input Group. The toggle is a toggle button: a constant name ("Show password") and `aria-pressed`.

inputs.name: visible
inputs.description: Shows the password as plain text (`[(visible)]`).

inputs.name: ariaDescribedby
inputs.description: Extra ids for `aria-describedby` on the input.

inputs.name: toggleLabel
inputs.description: The toggle's accessible name; its state is `aria-pressed`.

symbols.name: SonePowerSliderComponent
symbols.description: Dragging fires `input` continuously (preview only); only `change` (release / keyboard settle) commits `value` and `onChange` once — otherwise dragging past the end would persist every rung on the way.

symbols.name: SoneRatingComponent
symbols.description: Stars for a score. Read-only (`readonly`) it is one image named "4.5 out of 5" and fills fractions; interactive it is a native radio group — arrow keys move the score, every star is a labelled radio — and a ControlValueAccessor of `number` (0 = no rating).

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The score, 0 to `max`. Fractions show only when read-only.

inputs.name: readonly
inputs.description: Show the score without letting it change.

inputs.name: clearable
inputs.description: Choosing the current score again clears it to 0.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: The group's accessible name (interactive) or a prefix of the image's (read-only).

symbols.name: SoneElapsedTimerComponent
symbols.description: `<sone-elapsed-timer>` — a running time (`12:04`, `1:02:07`) in tabular mono figures, as a `<time>` with an ISO 8601 `datetime`.

inputs.name: seconds
inputs.description: Elapsed whole seconds.

inputs.name: live
inputs.description: A running clock: `role="timer"` (never announced on every tick).

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: The timer's name when `live` (“Recording time”).

inputs.name: level
inputs.description: The current input level, 0..1 — drives the synthetic sway.

inputs.name: history
inputs.description: Recent levels (0..1), oldest first. When set, each bar draws one real sample (the newest at the end, missing ones as silence) instead of the sway.

symbols.name: SoneProcessingStatusComponent
symbols.description: `<sone-processing-status>` — where a recording is in the pipeline: the processing orb, the stage label and a thin `<sone-progress>`. A polite live region (`role="status"`), so a stage change is announced once.

inputs.name: stage
inputs.description: `recording`, `transcribing`, `summarizing`, `exporting`, `saved`, `finalized`, `done`, `error` or your own.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Overrides for the built-in stage labels; an unknown stage shows itself capitalised.

inputs.name: message
inputs.description: A live detail that replaces the stage label while it is non-empty (“Transcribing 3 of 7…”).

inputs.name: progress
inputs.description: 0..1; `null` = indeterminate.

inputs.name: showProgress
inputs.description: Draw the progress track (off for a compact row status).

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: `idle` (start), `recording` (stop), `paused` (resume), `processing` (busy).

inputs.name: withLabel
inputs.description: A pill with the glyph and the button's own text (`<button soneRecordButton withLabel>Record</button>`). Off = the round icon-only button.

symbols.name: SoneRecordingIndicatorComponent
symbols.description: `<sone-recording-indicator>` — “a recording is running”: the live (or paused) status orb, the elapsed timer and an optional label, in one row.

inputs.name: seconds
inputs.description: Elapsed whole seconds.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible text after the timer (“Recording”); `null` = none.

inputs.name: timerLabel
inputs.default: $localize`:Accessible name of the running recording clock:Recording time`
inputs.description: The timer's accessible name.

outputs.name: save
outputs.description: The parent must not log or store this outside the Keychain.

inputs.name: ariaDescribedby
inputs.description: Extra ids for `aria-describedby` on the inner `<select>`.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The selected value for `[(value)]`. `valueChange` fires only when the user picks an option — a forms write (`writeValue` from `formControl` / `ngModel`) updates the display without emitting it.

outputs.name: selectionChange
outputs.description: Fires ONLY when the user picks an option — never on any programmatic write.

symbols.name: SoneSidebarComponent
symbols.description: `sidebar.css` is global, not component-scoped: the app shell must be styled before Angular boots (WKWebView cold-launch FOUC fix, see app-shell). `collapsible` defaults to `"none"`, not spartan's `"offcanvas"`: this same part is also the static section rail in the Settings dialog, which must not collapse whenever the app-wide sidebar does.

inputs.name: expandedHint
inputs.default: $localize`Click to collapse · drag to resize · ⌥-click to reset width`

symbols.name: SoneSidebarWrapperDirective
symbols.description: ⌘B/Ctrl+B also toggles Bold in `sone-markdown-editor`, which calls `preventDefault()` on the textarea before this document-level listener runs, so it stands down there and never fires inside any editable field.

symbols.name: SoneSparklineComponent
symbols.description: `<sone-sparkline>` — a word-sized chart with no axes: a line, an area, bars or a heat strip in one stretched `<svg>`. Decorative by default (next to a number that already says it); pass `[decorative]="false"` to make it an image with a spoken summary.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: The series, oldest first.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: `line` | `area` | `bar` | `heat` (cells on the sequential ramp).

inputs.name: min
inputs.description: The bottom of the scale.

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: The top of the scale; defaults to `niceCeiling(values, 4)`.

inputs.name: tone
inputs.description: The colour (`heat` uses the sequential ramp instead).

inputs.name: decorative
inputs.description: Hidden from assistive technology (default); `false` makes it `role="img"`.

inputs.name: summary
inputs.description: The spoken text when not decorative; defaults to “n values, peak x, total y”.

symbols.name: SoneSpeakerChipComponent
symbols.description: `<sone-speaker-chip>` — who is talking: initials in a tone-coloured avatar plus the speaker's name, both derived from one speaker key (`me`, `others`, `others-0`, `speaker-2`) with `speakerLabel()` / `speakerTone()`.

inputs.name: speaker
inputs.description: The speaker key; an unknown key is shown as it is.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Replaces the derived name (a real participant name, say).

symbols.name: SoneStackedBarComponent
symbols.description: `<sone-stacked-bar>` — one bar split into the parts of a whole (storage by kind, checks by state). With `max` above the sum, the rest shows as the empty track. The bar is `role="img"` named by a generated summary ("Storage: Playback 4.2 GB (40%), …; 7.6 GB of 20 GB"); `valueLabel` formats the values (bytes, durations), `locale` the numbers and percentages.

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: The whole the parts are measured against; `null` (default) = their sum.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: What the bar measures ("Storage"); starts the spoken summary.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale for numbers and percentages; defaults to the active `$localize` locale.

inputs.name: valueLabel
inputs.description: Formats one value for the summary and the legend; default: a localized number.

inputs.name: emptyLabel
inputs.default: $localize`:Stacked bar with nothing to show:No data`

symbols.name: SoneStatDirective
symbols.description: `div[soneStat]` — one figure: a `dt[soneStatLabel]`, a `dd[soneStatValue]` and optional `dd[soneStatHint]` / `dd[soneStatTrend]`. The DOM keeps `dt` first; `labelPosition="bottom"` only moves it visually. Set `--i` (`[style.--i]="$index"`) to stagger the entry animation.

inputs.name: labelPosition
inputs.description: Where the label sits visually; the DOM order (dt before dd) never changes.

symbols.name: SoneStatGroupDirective
symbols.description: `dl[soneStatGroup]` — a row or grid of key figures. The `<dl>` keeps each label paired with its value for screen readers; every `[soneStat]` inside is a `<div>` that groups one `dt` with its `dd`s.

inputs.name: layout
inputs.description: `grid` fills the width in equal tracks; `inline` is a wrapping row of figures.

inputs.name: columns
inputs.description: A fixed number of grid columns; `null` (the default) auto-fits ~10rem tracks.

inputs.name: separated
inputs.description: Hairlines between the figures (a joined panel in `grid`, rules in `inline`).

symbols.name: SoneStatHintDirective
symbols.description: `dd[soneStatHint]` — a quiet line of context under the value.

symbols.name: SoneStatLabelDirective
symbols.description: `dt[soneStatLabel]` — what the figure counts.

symbols.name: SoneStatTrendComponent
symbols.description: `dd[soneStatTrend]` — the change since the last period. `delta`'s sign picks the arrow and, with `tone="auto"`, the colour (up = positive); set `tone` when up is bad (costs, errors). The visible text is projected — write the magnitude (`12%`); screen readers hear the direction first ("up 12%").

inputs.name: delta
inputs.description: The change; its sign sets the arrow. `null` hides the arrow.

inputs.name: upLabel
inputs.default: $localize`:Read before a figure that went up, e.g. "up 12%":up`

inputs.name: downLabel
inputs.default: $localize`:Read before a figure that went down, e.g. "down 3%":down`

inputs.name: flatLabel
inputs.default: $localize`:Read before a figure that did not change, e.g. "unchanged 0%":unchanged`

symbols.name: SoneStatValueDirective
symbols.description: `dd[soneStatValue]` — the figure itself, in tabular monospaced numerals.

symbols.name: SoneStepperComponent
symbols.description: Progress through a multi-step flow. `current` is the step INDEX, not its key: "Step x of y", `linear` and the completed / active / inactive split are index arithmetic, and a key is one `steps.findIndex()` away.

inputs.name: current
inputs.description: The active step's index (0-based); out-of-range values are clamped.

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: `dots` — the compact onboarding progress; `numbered` — circles with labels.

inputs.name: linear
inputs.description: Only completed steps and the active one can be clicked — never a later one.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Progress display only: the steps are not buttons.

inputs.name: showCount
inputs.description: The visible "Step x of y" text.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: The group's accessible name.

outputs.name: stepClick
outputs.description: A user picked a step (`current` is already updated).

symbols.name: SoneTagInputComponent
symbols.description: Tags as removable chips — a ControlValueAccessor of `string[]`. Enter or a comma adds the typed tag (a pasted "a, b, c" adds three), Backspace in the empty field removes the last one. Duplicates are refused case-insensitively.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: The text field's accessible name.

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: At most this many tags; further ones are rejected with reason `max`.

inputs.name: maxVisible
inputs.description: Show this many chips and a "+N more" toggle for the rest.

inputs.name: suggestions
inputs.description: Offered while typing (a native `<datalist>`).

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Return `false` to refuse a tag (reason `invalid`).

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: The chips' badge variant.

symbols.name: SoneTooltipDirective
symbols.description: Replaces the host's native `title` rather than sitting beside it — both at once would show two tooltips. The bubble is `aria-hidden`; the control keeps naming itself as it already did, or a screen reader would announce the name twice.

inputs.name: soneTooltipSide
inputs.description: `null`: the side its container asks for (`SONE_TOOLTIP_SIDE`), else `bottom`.

symbols.name: SoneTreeDirective
symbols.description: `[soneTree]` — the WAI-ARIA tree pattern over FLAT rows (`sone-tree-row`, or any element with `[soneTreeItem]`): `role="tree"`, one Tab stop (roving tabindex), ↑ / ↓ move, → expands or enters the first child, ← collapses or goes to the parent, Home / End, typeahead, Enter / Space activate and `*` expands every sibling. Rows keep rendering only what is expanded; the tree reads their order from the DOM and their level from `aria-level`. Expand / collapse only change state; the rows they add or remove appear on the next render. A navigation key that lands before it (key repeat, a fast typist) would walk the stale rows, so it is held and replayed on the row once that render is done.

symbols.name: SoneTreeItemDirective
symbols.description: `[soneTreeItem]` — makes any element a row of the enclosing `[soneTree]` (for rows that are not `sone-tree-row`, such as a "View all" link): `role="treeitem"`, `aria-level`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-selected` and the roving tabindex. Enter / Space click it; →/← emit `expandedChange`.

inputs.name: level
inputs.description: 1-based nesting level.

symbols.name: SoneTreeRowComponent
symbols.description: Nesting is DRAWN, not built: consumers stay FLAT (one `@for` over depth-tagged lines) rather than a recursive component pair, so there is no T2 cycle risk. Owns 100% of the row's visual box so a Meetings row and a Notes row never diverge; feature-specific content projects in as trailing `<ng-content>`. Inside a `[soneTree]` (`@surface-one/angular/tree`) the row becomes a `role="treeitem"` with `aria-level` / `aria-expanded` / `aria-selected` and the tree's roving tabindex; its own buttons leave the Tab order. Outside a tree it renders exactly as before.

inputs.name: level
inputs.description: `aria-level` inside a `[soneTree]` (default: `depth + 1`).

inputs.name: hasChildren
inputs.description: Whether the row has children, for `aria-expanded` (default: `expandable`).
